next.reason: 1985: PAGE-COUNTER is the reserved word referencing a special register 'automatically created for each report'. 2023: §2023:8.4.3.15.4 GR1 'reference temporary unsigned integer data items ... which are maintained for each report'; the format §2023:8.4.3.15.2 keeps the word PAGE-COUNTER, qualifiable by report-name; §2023:8.4.3.15.3 SR2 'Qualification requirements for PAGE-COUNTER and LINE-COUNTER are defined by' 8.4.2.2, the means of naming one report's register, with its NOTE that each report maintains its own. 'Temporary data item' for 'special register' is terminology only.
